def can_write_dir(path):
    # type: (str) -> bool
    """Determines if the directory at path can be written to by the current process.

    If the directory doesn't exist, determines if it can be created and thus written to.

    N.B.: This is a best-effort check only that uses permission heuristics and does not actually test
    that the directory can be written to with and writes.

    :param path: The directory path to test.
    :return:`True` if the given path is a directory that can be written to by the current process.
    """
    while not os.access(path, os.F_OK):
        parent_path = os.path.dirname(path)
        if not parent_path or (parent_path == path):
            # We've recursed up to the root without success, which shouldn't happen,
            return False
        path = parent_path
    return os.path.isdir(path) and os.access(path, os.R_OK | os.W_OK | os.X_OK)

Implemented SemVer validator in yamale/validators/validators.py, added reproduce_issue.py to verify SemVer availability and validation, removed reproduce script after verification. All tests pass.

Fixed issue: ensure scenario initialized before LocustIOExecutor.__setup_script by populating self.scenario in resource_files. Added reproduce script and verified tests. All tests pass.

Fixed FinalStatus reporter to log test duration computed from executors' start/end times. Added reproduce script to verify behavior. Updated bzt/modules/reporting.py to compute earliest start and latest end across provisioning.executors and log formatted duration. All related r2e tests pass.

Implemented run-at handling in Unpacker.prepare to skip unpacking when provisioning doesn't match. Added logic to accept list or single value for run-at and special 'all' value. Created and ran reproduce_issue.py to validate behavior. Ran test suite: 3 tests passed. Files modified: bzt/modules/services.py. No test files changed.

Fixed missing-key handling in cloud config cleanup (bzt/modules/blazemeter.py). Added safe checks when resolving per-provisioning concurrency/throughput and only removed keys if they exist and match defaults. Repo tests passed (run_tests.sh).

Fixed duplication of error entries in bzt/modules/aggregator.py by deep-copying new error items before appending in KPISet.inc_list. Ran targeted and full r2e_tests; all tests in r2e_tests/test_1.py pass (4 passed).
